title: Professional Email Seats and the Harborline Cloud 8 Upgrade Charge
content:
**Support training Q&A — Professional Email and Cloud 8 upgrades on Web Hosting Plans**

**The rule.** The Cloud 8 upgrade charge is reduced by a mail bundle credit when a Harborline email subscription (Professional Email) in status active serves the plan's primary domain: USD 20.00 when that subscription has at least 5 seats, USD 10.00 when it has fewer; a plan whose primary domain has no active Harborline email subscription receives no mail bundle credit.

*Q: Which subscription is looked at?* A: An active Professional Email subscription whose email domain is the plan's primary domain.

*Q: The subscription has exactly 5 seats.* A: That is at least 5 seats: USD 20.00.

*Q: It has 3 seats.* A: Fewer than 5: USD 10.00.

*Q: The customer's only Professional Email subscription serves a different domain, or is no longer active.* A: The plan's primary domain then has no active Harborline email subscription, and no mail bundle credit is given.
